phase3_findings.description: The comment above _PARSE_REFUSAL_MARKERS says test_safety_rule_sets pins every marker to its message, but no test exercises the 'could not resolve SQL dialect' or 'empty parse tree' markers; a reworded readonly.py message would silently stop redaction matching.

safety/__init__.py docstring (and whole_row.py:197, read-only-safety.md:17 and :207) says the whole-row guard sits directly beneath result masking; with a rule-set file RefusalRedactingRunner sits between them.

_check_rule_set_catalog reports every non-RuleSetCatalogError failure as an information_schema privilege problem, so a lost connection, timeout or programming error gets a misleading remedy (fails closed, cause chained).
